 ### Acceptance Criteria  
   
 ```gherkin
 Given [some context]
 When [certain action is taken]
 Then [the outcome of action is observed]
 ```

### Definition of Done
- Feature implementation is completed according to the acceptance criteria.
- Frontend and backend integration works correctly.
- No critical bugs, crashes, or blocking issues remain.
- API endpoints and business logic function correctly.
- Database changes and migrations are successfully applied.
- Error handling and validation are implemented.
- Docker build and application startup run successfully.
- Source code is pushed and merged into the repository.
